verdict.rationale: Dover is an ATS/CRM that documents collecting structured interviewer feedback, emailing candidates through outreach campaigns, keeping in touch with them in a CRM, and collaborative notes, and it claims full visibility into candidates. That implies a candidate record holding some of these elements, but nothing explicitly describes a single unified profile. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a unified candidate profile, resume storage on the record, email threads synced to the profile, an activity history/timeline, consent status tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record

citations.quote: collect structured feedback from every interviewer
email them with outreach campaigns, and keep in touch with people in the CRM
Full visibility into candidates, costs, and conversion.
